s8.title: 7558 ALT-F4 Behind the Bumpers, filmed at the championship (auto-caption read)

outcome.text: 51-17-0 in official play; ranked 7 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 326.83, Johnson).

auto.text: PathPlanner autos replaced drive-to-point ones, which did not behave the same in simulation and on the field. The robot detects crossing the bump from its tilt, waits a set time, then resets its pose. A second, side Limelight made autos more accurate.

cycle.text: Fuel goes from a sliding intake through the indexer to a drum four fuel wide. Pose gives distance and heading, and a lookup table sets hood and flywheel, held at speed while driving. The feeder runs only at speed, and the intake moves inward during the shot.

fallback.text: The robot tracks motor current and temperature and switches to a lower power mode on a brownout or from that data, so the battery drains much more slowly.

gave_up.text: A little top speed: the drive is geared 7.13:1 so the robot gets moving faster out of every stop.

changed.text: The first design, Vibez, a turret fed by a spindexer with an L1 hang, was shelved because its ceiling was too low.

After the first event a steep intake that jammed when hit was made more horizontal. The hopper went from no net to a stiff net to a stretchy one. Silicone-tubing feed rollers lost grip to debris; the main one is now grip tape, secondary ones still silicone.

facts.text: SDS MK5N modules, gear ratio
The belly pan carries the roboRIO, power distribution and battery low in the frame
Eight quick-release nuts hold the bumpers; the team says a swap takes thirty seconds

solves.text: Collect without jamming when hit, and let the front hopper squeeze fuel harder for more fuel per second

facts.text: A 2 in polycarbonate roller on a dead axle, driven by two Kraken X60s at 1.67:1
A laminated Lexan rack with 10 DP teeth, driven by one Kraken X60 at 15:1; a through-shaft links both sides so it cannot skew
Tilt
A churro kicker bar wrapped in cat-tongue tape hangs on a pivot, held by surgical tubing

cost.text: The steeper version used at the first event jammed a lot

functions.name: Hopper

solves.text: Go under the trench empty, then carry extra fuel above the walls without it spilling

functions.type: moving and stationary hopper with a stretchy net

facts.text: Capacity with the stretchy net, up to about
Diamond-lattice Lexan walls, part fixed to the shooter and part moving with the intake
Comes off with four bolts

solves.text: Feed fast from the hopper to the shooter without slipping

facts.text: One Kraken X60 drives all five rollers at the same surface speed
Each roller drops out on its own; the team says in under a minute
Two Kraken X60s drive the feeder rollers at 12:20
An agitation roller off the main feeder, through 1.5:1, pushes fuel down instead of letting it popcorn

cost.text: Silicone tubing collected fuel debris, and balls slipped or jammed; the secondary rollers are still silicone tubing

functions.name: Drum shooter

solves.text: Keep shots consistent as the hopper empties

functions.type: four-wide drum shooter with adjustable hood

facts.text: Four Kraken X60s drive the drum 1:1
A custom-cut steel flywheel, 1/2 in thick and 4 in, is geared 3:1 from the drum
The drum is geared 1.56:1 to the back hood rollers so fuel leaves with minimum spin
Hood travel

solves.text: Aim from distance with no ballistics math on the robot

facts.text: Rows come from measured test shots; the code interpolates between the nearest entries
The flywheel is held at table speed while moving, so a shot waits only on the feeder

solves.text: Autos were inconsistent on one camera

facts.text: A front Limelight aligns to the hub; a side one was added
Each camera rejects outliers, picks MegaTag 1 or 2 with hysteresis, and feeds the pose estimator

solves.text: Many running motors drain the battery very quickly

facts.text: A web app shows supply current, current limits and temperature for each motor

decisions.because: there is no custom-module risk in build season
the robot gets moving faster out of every stop
the steeper one jammed when the robot crashed or was hit

decisions.choice: A steel flywheel on the drum
decisions.because: without it shots spread more and the last ones missed as the wheel slowed
shots are more accurate with no spin
adding a distance is one more row, not a retune
simulation and the real robot match better, and the team has no field

decisions.choice: Grip tape on the main feeder roller
decisions.because: it has worked best of three materials
